title: The Space Manage panel links to everything: the full console, the web editor, the website and the menu

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16: could not find the Space management console; asked that Manage open the panel with links to everything including website and web editor.

detail: SpaceManageBoard renders ManageQuickLinks above the console tabs once its manage gate passes. In the in-place ?panel=manage panel it shows Full console (/spaces/<slug>/manage), Web editor (/edit-page), Website (the live site in a new tab once published, else the Profile & Settings tab where the Website card publishes it) and Menu and features (/manage/modules). On /manage itself the full-console door is dropped.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/manage-board.tsx','utf8');const q=fs.existsSync('components/spaces/manage-quick-links.tsx')?fs.readFileSync('components/spaces/manage-quick-links.tsx','utf8'):'';const bad=[];if(!b.includes('<ManageQuickLinks'))bad.push('Manage panel has no quick links');if(!q.includes('/edit-page'))bad.push('no web editor link');if(!q.includes('Full console'))bad.push('no full console link');if(!q.includes('siteSubdomainHost'))bad.push('no website link');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-971: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
